comparison.objective: Rotate each sparkling-wine bottle by an eighth turn while it remains seated neck-down in a pupitre.
comparison.physical_skill: Grip and rotate an unconstrained cylindrical object about an oblique axis without extracting it.
comparison.success_condition: Body requires each bottle to rotate 30–60 degrees while retaining pose, with zero for excessive extraction; no versioned specs are present.
comparison.reason: Cylindrical fine rotation is shared, but riddling lacks tool engagement, unlocking/relocking, witness-torque retention, and outcome-based damper tuning.
